title: nan
authors: Trigkakis D.; Petrakis G.; Tripolitsiotis A.; Partsinevelos P.
key_contribution: Presents a visual rapid mapping and geolocation framework using camera-equipped UAVs, local SLAM coordinate systems, and line/plane alignment optimization in GNSS-degraded urban environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
